svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: How the SME Quote Dashboard is built
Everything stays inside the firm's own Microsoft 365 and Azure · one company login · the data never leaves the firm
The pipeline signs in as its own app,
not as a person. Staff use the
Pulls every source file from SharePoint
Runs the workbook's 16 steps, rewritten in Python
Checks its own totals on every run
Hands out a one-hour pass to read the figures
Runs only when someone presses Refresh now,
so there is no server to look after
Azure Storage · private, no public access
only tested changes reach the dashboard
Refresh now, asks for a pass

g.text: 1 · The data: Excel files stay on SharePoint, as always
2 · Anyone presses Refresh now in the dashboard
3 · The engine pulls every file from SharePoint, read-only
4 · It runs the workbook's 16 steps, rewritten in Python
5 · The result is saved as one private data file
6 · Staff log in with their company Microsoft account
7 · The page gets a one-hour pass to read the figures
8 · Every tab, filter and drill-down then works instantly
